target_hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (~91 GB Usable VRAM)

Scenario_A_Evict_Every_Stage.description: Legacy T4 pattern: Load model -> Run inference -> Force gc.collect() + empty_cache() -> Unload
Scenario_A_Evict_Every_Stage.time_penalty_per_invocation: Severe: Reloading 15-30 GB weights from host PCIe introduces 4-12 second latency penalty per stage
Scenario_A_Evict_Every_Stage.suitability_for_blackwell: DEPRECATED: Unnecessary VRAM thrashing on a 91 GB GPU

Scenario_B_Persistent_Resident_Pool.description: Blackwell high-VRAM pattern: Load core workers (Depth Anything 4GB + SAM2 6GB + MASt3R 10GB + TRELLIS 14GB = 34GB) into persistent VRAM pool
Scenario_B_Persistent_Resident_Pool.memory_footprint_gb: 34 GB resident footprint out of 85 GB managed budget (51 GB free for batch tensor operations)
Scenario_B_Persistent_Resident_Pool.time_penalty_per_invocation: Zero model reload overhead; sub-50ms execution dispatch per frame
